name: Deep Slumber
text:
**Deep Slumber**

**School** enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; **Level** arcanist 3, bard 3, mesmerist 3, occultist 3, psychic 3, sahirafiyun 3, shaman 3, skald 3, sorcerer 3, witch 3, wizard 3
**Casting Time** 1 round
**Components** V, S, M (fine sand, rose petals, or a live cricket)
**Range** close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
**Area** one or more living creatures within a 10-ft.-radius burst
**Duration** 1 min./level
**Saving Throw** Will negates; **Spell Resistance** yes

This spell functions like sleep, except that it affects 10 HD of targets.
